```{r extra-setup, include=FALSE}
library(magick)
library(knitr)
```

### f) Additional Analyses {.tabset}

```{r extra-tabs, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tabs <- lapply(seq_along(imgInfo$extra), function(i) {
  item  <- imgInfo$extra[[i]]
  title <- item$title
  token <- item$token

  # dirInfo$image.wd is always absolute (set via Go_dirInfo/setwd)
  hits <- list.files(
    dirInfo$image.wd,
    pattern    = sprintf(".*%s.*\\.pdf$", token),
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    return(knitr::knit_child(
      text  = c(paste0("#### ", title), "",
                paste0("*(extra.(", token, ") PDF not found in ", dirInfo$image.wd, ")*"), ""),
      quiet = TRUE, envir = environment()
    ))
  }

  pdf_p <- hits[1]
  png_p <- sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", pdf_p, ignore.case = TRUE)

  magick::image_read_pdf(pdf_p, pages = 1) |>
    magick::image_convert("png") |>
    magick::image_write(png_p)

  img_width <- if (!is.null(item$out_width)) item$out_width else "75%"

  knitr::knit_child(
    text = c(
      paste0("#### ", title),
      "",
      paste0("```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='", img_width, "', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}"),
      paste0("knitr::include_graphics('", png_p, "')"),
      "```",
      ""
    ),
    quiet = TRUE, envir = environment()
  )
})

cat(unlist(tabs), sep = "\n")
```
